# 2026-11-10 fixture

`judgments.json` is the real 2026-11-10 meme pack converted to the new schema
(scores, verdicts, reasons and how-to text unchanged). The registry rows it
needs are the repo's own `data/memes.csv`, which was seeded from the same pack.

`raw/` is **synthetic test data**. The repo never kept that day's raw snapshots,
so these rows are small, hand-made inputs that exercise the share-rate,
lifecycle, coverage and rendering code. A few values echo numbers quoted in the
old pack text; the rest are made up. Never cite them as evidence.
